description: Render the new fields on both detail pages: campaign_detail_screen.dart and job_detail_screen.dart show Rules (if present), the Demo Asset per type (inline image / tappable video link / 'View PDF' via url_launcher / tappable external link / text block), and platform pills (split from the comma-joined string). Every section renders ONLY when its data exists. Depends on FEAT-001/FEAT-002 having written the data; reads columns from the SELECT * map by key (never named in a select). Independent-ish: can be built once the map keys are known.
steps: In lib/features/campaigns/screens/campaign_detail_screen.dart _CampaignDetailScrollView.build: the existing code already reads campaign['platform'] as a single string. Change platform handling to split the comma-joined string into a List<String> (split on ',', trim, drop empties). Render each platform as its own pill in the existing pills Wrap (reuse _Pill/_PillData and the existing _platformIcon helper). Also read rules = (campaign['rules'] ?? '').toString(), demoType = (campaign['demo_asset_type'] ?? '').toString(), demoUrl = (campaign['demo_asset_url'] ?? '').toString().

Add a 'Rules' section to campaign_detail_screen.dart rendered ONLY when rules.isNotEmpty, styled like the existing 'Requirements'/guidelines card (h6 heading + bordered card with textSecondary body). Place it near the guidelines/description sections.

Add a 'Demo Asset' section to campaign_detail_screen.dart rendered ONLY when demoType.isNotEmpty && demoUrl.isNotEmpty. Build a reusable private widget (e.g. _DemoAssetSection) shared in spirit with the job detail one; render by type: image -> Image.network in a rounded clipped container with errorBuilder; video -> a tappable card ('Watch Video') that opens demoUrl via url_launcher launchUrl(Uri.parse(...), mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication); pdf -> a tappable 'View PDF' card opening demoUrl via url_launcher; link -> a tappable 'Open Link' card showing the URL and opening it via url_launcher; text -> a bordered card showing the raw text (demoUrl holds the text for the text type). Use Iconsax icons (gallery/video/document/link/document-text) and dark-mode-safe colors.

In lib/features/jobs/screens/job_detail_screen.dart _JobDetailScrollView.build: read platforms (split job['platform'] comma string), rules = job['rules'], demoType = job['demo_asset_type'], demoUrl = job['demo_asset_url']. Render platform pills (only if non-empty) - reuse the existing _CategoryPill style or add a small pills Wrap consistent with the screen; render a 'Rules' section (only if rules non-empty) styled like the existing description/_WhatToSubmitCard cards; render a 'Demo Asset' section (only if demoType && demoUrl non-empty) with the SAME per-type rendering as the campaign detail (image inline, video/pdf/link tappable via url_launcher, text block).

Factor the per-type demo-asset rendering so both screens behave identically - either a shared widget in lib/core/widgets/demo_asset_view.dart used by both detail screens, or an equivalent private widget duplicated with identical behavior. Prefer a shared lib/core/widgets/demo_asset_view.dart (DemoAssetView({required String type, required String value})) to avoid drift, and use it in both detail screens. It must import url_launcher (available, ^6.2.0) for video/pdf/link.
Ensure all new sections are individually guarded so nothing renders when empty, and colors branch on Theme brightness (AppColors.dark* vs light) for dark-mode safety.
acceptance_criteria: campaign_detail_screen.dart renders one pill per platform (split from comma string), a Rules card when campaign['rules'] is non-empty, and a Demo Asset section matching campaign['demo_asset_type'] when both type and url are non-empty.
job_detail_screen.dart renders platform pills, a Rules section, and a Demo Asset section under the same conditions from the job map.

Demo asset rendering: image shows inline (Image.network with errorBuilder); video, pdf and link open via url_launcher externalApplication; text shows as an inline text card. A shared DemoAssetView widget (lib/core/widgets/demo_asset_view.dart) is used by both screens (or identical behavior is guaranteed).
Every new section is hidden when its data is empty; no new column is named inside any .select(...) projection; colors are dark-mode-safe.
All changed/created .dart files have balanced braces and parentheses.
verification: Read both detail screens and confirm each new section is wrapped in an isNotEmpty guard.
Confirm demo_asset rendering uses url_launcher for video/pdf/link and Image.network for image; confirm text type renders the value inline.
grep both detail files + demo_asset_view.dart for .select( and confirm no new column name appears in a projection (these screens don't query, but confirm anyway).
Balance-check braces/parens in campaign_detail_screen.dart, job_detail_screen.dart, and demo_asset_view.dart.
findings: Created lib/core/widgets/demo_asset_view.dart: DemoAssetView({required String type, required String value}) renders per stored key - image -> Image.network in a rounded ClipRRect container with errorBuilder fallback; video -> tappable 'Watch Video' card; pdf -> tappable 'View PDF' card; link -> tappable 'Open Link' card showing the URL; all three launch via url_launcher launchUrl(Uri.parse(value), mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication) (uses Uri.tryParse for safety); text -> bordered card showing raw text. All colors branch on Theme brightness (AppColors.dark* variants). Widget is defensive: returns SizedBox.shrink() when type/value empty. Used by BOTH detail screens for zero drift. campaign_detail_screen.dart: added platforms = campaign['platform'] split(',')/trim/dropEmpty -> one _Pill per platform via existing _platformIcon; added Rules card (guarded rules.isNotEmpty) styled like Requirements/guidelines card; added Demo Asset section (guarded demoType.isNotEmpty && demoUrl.isNotEmpty) using DemoAssetView, placed after Requirements. Kept existing single-string `platform` for subtitle/detail-row text unchanged. job_detail_screen.dart: added platforms split from job['platform'] rendered as pills in a Wrap alongside the existing category pill via new _PlatformPill widget; added Rules section (guarded) and Demo Asset section (guarded) after _WhatToSubmitCard. All reads are by-key off the SELECT * maps; no new column named in any .select projection (grep confirmed no .select( in any of the 3 files). Verification (no Flutter SDK, INTEGRATIONS_ONLY): brace/paren/bracket balance PASS for all 3 files; confirmed url_launcher ^6.2.0 in pubspec, AppTextStyles/AppColors/AppRadius/AppSpacing imports present, Iconsax icons (gallery/video/document/link/arrow_right_3) exist in app_icons.dart. Could not run flutter analyze/build/test (SDK absent). --- v1 SEMANTIC REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-09-20-113251-review.md): (Issue 2, un-split platform text in campaign_detail_screen.dart) FIXED - added `platformsLabel = platforms.join(', ')` (from the already-split list) and swapped it into both the brand `subtitleParts` and the 'Content Type' detail row so a multi-platform campaign now shows 'Instagram, Facebook' instead of the raw comma-joined 'Instagram,Facebook'. The .isNotEmpty gates still key off the raw `platform` string (correct - just presence checks). No unrelated logic touched; still dark-mode-safe. (Issue 3, platform icon fallback, LOW PRIORITY) FIXED - checked lib/core/icons/app_icons.dart: it maps Iconsax->Phosphor duotone and previously exposed only `instagram` (instagramLogo), so Facebook/YouTube fell back to the globe. Added `Iconsax.facebook = PhosphorIconsDuotone.facebookLogo` and `Iconsax.youtube = PhosphorIconsDuotone.youtubeLogo` (same *Logo convention as the working instagramLogo mapping, phosphor_flutter ^2.1.0). Mapped them in campaign_detail_screen `_platformIcon` and job_detail_screen `_PlatformPill._icon` (contains('face') / contains('you')), giving all three selector platforms (Instagram/Facebook/YouTube) matching icons; globe remains as the fallback for any other value. NOTE: Flutter SDK/pub cache absent (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY), so the exact Phosphor constant names could not be compiled-verified; facebookLogo/youtubeLogo are long-standing Phosphor icons and follow the same naming as the already-shipping instagramLogo. Re-ran brace/paren/bracket balance on app_icons.dart, campaign_detail_screen.dart, job_detail_screen.dart: all PASS.
